steps: Obtain Moomoo OpenAPI access using OAuth 2.1 + PKCE or runtime API key, according to provider entitlement.
Set MOOMOO_ACCESS_TOKEN or MOOMOO_API_KEY only in local/runtime environment; never commit it.
Execute the four request families in the request plan under the user's entitled markets/data permissions.
Export provider responses into market-provider-intake-v1.json using the import template with secrets removed.
Run npm run build:runtime-position-48:w8a:p2 to normalize and hash payloads.
Review normalized snapshots before creating W8B provider claims.
